meaning: 优先处理；确定优先顺序
enExample: You need to prioritize your tasks to meet the deadline.
zhExample: 你需要优先处理任务以赶上截止日期。
note: 词根 prior（先前的）+ ize（使...化）→ 让某事排在前面

enExample: The deadline for submitting the report is this Friday.
zhExample: 提交报告的截止日期是本周五。
note: dead（死）+ line（线）→ 逾期不候的“死线”

enExample: I would appreciate any feedback on my presentation.
zhExample: 我非常欢迎对我的演示提出任何反馈。
note: feed（输送）+ back（返回）→ 信息“返送”回来

meaning: 积极主动的；先发制人的
enExample: Being proactive can help you seize opportunities before others.
zhExample: 积极主动能帮助你抢在别人之前抓住机会。
note: pro（向前）+ active（活跃的）→ 提前行动，而非被动等待

enExample: Could you clarify your point? I didn't quite understand.
zhExample: 你能阐明你的观点吗？我没太听懂。
note: 词根 clar（清楚的，如 clear）+ ify（使...）→ 使变清楚
